title: SCIM provisioning: exponential backoff, observability, and graceful deprovisioning
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Problem: We see intermittent 5xx and network timeouts when pushing user/group changes to some customer IdPs. Current behavior retries immediately and creates noisy error spikes in metrics and repeated provisioning calls. Deprovisioning currently performs immediate hard deletes for some internal flows which risks orphaned audit trails and customer confusion. Goals: 1) implement a robust, configurable retry/backoff strategy with jitter for SCIM provisioning and deprovisioning calls; 2) add comprehensive telemetry (metrics, traces, dashboards) and audit log enhancements so SRE/Support can triage provisioning incidents quickly; 3) change deprovisioning to a soft-delete + delayed hard-delete default with admin override; 4) gate changes behind a feature flag and rollout canary to Dedicated customers first.
acceptance_criteria: SCIM client implements exponential backoff with jitter, max attempts configurable (default 6) and max backoff 300s
All provisioning and deprovisioning attempts emit metrics: scim.requests_total, scim.attempts, scim.failures, scim.latency_seconds
Traces include correlation_id and tenant_id for every SCIM request; integration with existing tracing headers
Audit logs record provision/deprovision actions (actor, timestamp, resource, truncated response, request_id) and are queryable via Console audit UI
Deprovisioning uses soft-delete by default with a 7-day grace period (configurable per-tenant). Admins can force immediate hard-delete via Console API with audit record
Feature flag scim_retry_v2 controls rollout; automated smoke tests for staging and a canary plan for Dedicated customers exist
End-to-end tests and a load test validate no token storming under intermittent IdP failures
notes: Prototype PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2987 (initial backoff implementation + unit tests)
Related incident: INC-2026-01-09 - repeated provisioning failures for tenant 'acme-corp' (postmortem linked in Confluence)

updates: 2026-02-20 - Triage: scoped work to retry policy + observability + deprovisioning path. Assigned to Luca. P1 due to multiple customer incidents.

2026-02-24 - Spike complete: measured failure modes against Okta and OneLogin test tenants. Observed 40% of transient failures recoverable within 3s. Chose exponential backoff with decorrelated jitter (following AWS guidance).
2026-02-28 - Implemented client-side backoff with feature flag 'scim_retry_v2' behind config. Unit tests and local integration tests added. PR opened: #2987.

2026-03-02 - Added Prometheus metrics in client: scim_requests_total, scim_attempts_total, scim_failures_total, scim_last_status_code. Instrumentation reviewed by observability team. Draft Grafana panels created.

2026-03-04 - Deprovisioning workflow reworked to soft-delete: added tombstone record + scheduled job for hard-delete. Default grace period set to 7 days. Added admin endpoint for immediate hard-delete with additional audit entry. PR #3012 opened for deprov workflow.

2026-03-05 - Load test against simulated flaky IdP: backoff reduces retries by 62% and lowers request spikes. Two follow-ups: (1) add tenant-level override for max_attempts, (2) redact sensitive fields from stored audit payloads. Planning next-stage canary for Dedicated tenants.
QA checklist: staging smoke, e2e provisioning tests, canary rollout plan, compliance review scheduled
